sources.citation: Reid, Lawrence A. (ed.). 1971. Philippine minor languages: word lists and phonologies. Oceanic Linguistics Special Publication 8. Honolulu: University of Hawaii Press. Atta (Pamplona) section.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: open copy online; also in print at Harvard (Widener Library, call number Philol 961.5 no.8) (also digitized at HathiTrust, search-only (in copyright))
sources.harvard_location: Widener Library, call number Philol 961.5 no.8
sources.note: The only published phonology sketch of any Atta variety; each sketch in this volume gives phonemes and normally a stress/accent statement. It describes Pamplona Atta [att] (pamp1246? — closest relative, 'very similar'), so any stress rule found there would be second-hand for Pudtol Atta and needs an identity note.
No descriptive references: only Reid 2006 (subclassification comment) and Ethnologue. Glottolog lists no grammar, sketch or phonology.

sources.note: Only a notational convention: 'Where stress has been indicated, it is marked as an acute accent on the stressed vowel.' (p. 10). Its Atta wordlist is 'Atta; ATT; Pamplona, Cagayan; PML' (Appendix A, p. 28), i.e. Reid 1971's Pamplona Atta data; no Pudtol Atta data and no stress rule.
